features.name: Requirements, Spec & Test Plan
features.description: Write docs/REQUIREMENTS.md (FR/NFR/AC + open questions), docs/SPEC.md (provider interfaces, polling/idempotency design, tooling + pinned versions, husky/commitlint, file tree, implementation order), docs/TEST-PLAN.md (test layers, fakes, case list, requirement traceability)
features.evidence: Uncommitted - docs/{REQUIREMENTS,SPEC,TEST-PLAN}.md written; cross-doc traceability checked, no code yet

features.name: Project Setup
features.description: Initialize package.json (pnpm, ESM, Node>=24), tsconfig, eslint flat config with the 3 boundary zones, vitest, prettier, husky+lint-staged+commitlint, .npmrc; switch init.sh and CLAUDE.md verification commands to pnpm; confirm clean checkout runs ./init.sh. See docs/SPEC.md sections 2.1-2.3.2 and 11 step 1

features.name: TrackerProvider Interface
features.description: Define src/providers/tracker/types.ts: TrackerProvider interface covering watch/poll status transitions, read issue body/comments, post comment, open PR/MR linked to issue, read PR/MR review state, update project board status field

features.name: GitHub TrackerProvider Implementation
features.description: Implement src/providers/tracker/github/ against TrackerProvider using gh CLI or Octokit, targeting GitHub Issues + Projects v2

features.name: AgentProvider Interface
features.description: Define src/providers/agent/types.ts: AgentProvider interface covering run(repoPath, taskDescription, worktreePath) -> { success, summary }, used for both plan-writing and implementation steps

features.name: Claude Code AgentProvider Implementation
features.description: Implement src/providers/agent/claude-code/ against AgentProvider, invoking Claude Code CLI in a given worktree

features.name: Orchestration State Machine
features.description: Implement src/orchestrator/ state machine: Ready -> Plan Written -> Approved -> Implementing -> Review -> Done, calling only TrackerProvider/AgentProvider interfaces (never concrete providers directly)

features.name: Plan Analysis Step (Ready -> Plan Written)
features.description: On issue Ready transition, invoke AgentProvider to analyze the issue and post a design/plan comment back to the issue via TrackerProvider

features.name: Implementation Step (Approved -> Review)
features.description: On human approval, clone repo, create worktree/branch, invoke AgentProvider to implement, run target repo's tests, open PR with Closes #N, move issue to Review

features.name: Revision Loop (Review -> Review)
features.description: On human PR change request, re-invoke AgentProvider against the same branch/worktree to address feedback, re-run tests, push update

features.name: Merge Reconciliation (Review -> Done)
features.description: Detect PR merge (via TrackerProvider), sync project board status to Done; rely on native issue auto-close from Closes #N, don't duplicate it

features.name: Verification Coverage
features.description: Unit tests for state machine transitions and both provider interfaces (with fakes), integration test against a real test repo/issue if feasible

features.name: Documentation Update
features.description: README covering setup, required env vars/tokens, how to add a new TrackerProvider or AgentProvider

features.name: Read-only Status UI
features.description: Implement src/http/ per docs/SPEC.md section 9.5: node:http zero-dependency server exposing GET /healthz, /readyz, /status (RuntimeSnapshot JSON) and / (self-contained auto-refreshing HTML page). Read-only, binds 127.0.0.1 by default, redacted, must not import concrete providers or call tracker APIs (AC-06). Snapshot seam lands earlier in feat-006

_evidenceStyle: Keep evidence to one line: commit hash + short pointer (e.g. 'Commit abc1234 - added X, tests pass'). Debugging narrative and design discussion belong in the commit message, not this file. See feature-list.schema.json.
